citation.description: Ticket has 2 extensive OSS research comments (local contention handling + git lock internals) plus operator-ratified decision comment. gitutil.py module docstring cites §1a/§2/§4/5b research sections at lines 17-38.

criteria.criterion: The OSS research findings are recorded on this ticket and the chosen approach cites them rather than asserting a value

citation.description: _with_index_lock_retry implements bounded jittered retry for both index.lock (_is_index_lock_error) and ref-lock (_is_git_lock_error) signatures. Tests test_transient_index_lock_from_competing_process_self_heals and test_transient_ref_lock_signature_is_retried in test_git_contention_9305.py cover this.

criteria.criterion: A transient index.lock or ref-lock conflict on a store git write self-heals with no error surfaced to the caller

citation.description: _augment_lock_exhaustion folds actionable guidance into stderr naming the lock file and remedy. _lock_retry_budget_s() returns ~21s nominal (pinned to [10s,60s] by test_default_retry_budget_is_tens_of_seconds). test_stuck_lock_surfaces_one_actionable_error covers this.

criteria.criterion: A permanently held lock yields exactly one actionable error naming the contended lock file and the remedy, after a bounded jittered budget on the order of tens of seconds by default

citation.description: _backoff_sleep seam routes all rebar deliberate backoff sleeps. test_uncontended_write_never_sleeps patches _backoff_sleep and asserts zero calls on the happy path. Advisory lock fast path uses non-blocking LOCK_NB flock (line 244).

criteria.criterion: Uncontended store git writes add no latency: no sleep on the happy path

citation.description: Module docstring explicitly states: bounded jittered retry + per-store advisory serialization; transient contention resolves silently (debug log only); only a stuck lock surfaces one actionable error naming the lock file. Cites OSS research (git lockfile.c, JGit, Mercurial, Bazel). States rationale for choosing over block-forever and fail-fast.

criteria.criterion: rebar's blocking policy under local contention is stated explicitly in gitutil.py's module docs
